headline: Dhaka: Criminals run amok with shootings and killings over trivial incidents
summary: A surge in violent crime in the capital city, where trivial disputes are escalating into deadly encounters.
details: Reports indicate a worrying trend of criminals operating with impunity in Dhaka, leading to an increase in violent incidents.
The city has seen a series of shootings and killings, often triggered by trivial matters that would otherwise not be escalate to violence.
Residents are expressing concern over the law and order situation as these violent clashes occur in various parts of the capital.
Authorities are being urged to take immediate action to curb the crime wave and restore safety for the citizens of Dhaka.

headline_marked: 5 students killed as [[student hostel collapses in New Delhi]]
headline: 5 students killed as student hostel collapses in New Delhi
summary: Rescue operations are underway in the Satya Niketan area as 40 to 50 students are feared trapped under the rubble of a collapsed PG hostel.
details: Five students have been killed after a multi-story student hostel (paying guest) collapsed in the Satya Niketan area of New Delhi, India.
One of the injured students died while undergoing treatment at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), bringing the death toll to five.
Rescue teams fear that 40 to 50 students may still be trapped under the debris. Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta stated that rescue efforts are being carried out with 'war-like' urgency.
Eleven students have been rescued so far and admitted to nearby hospitals. Two students at the AIIMS Trauma Center are reported to be in critical condition.
The collapse occurred around 1:34 PM on Sunday. Local police believe around 40 to 50 students were inside the building at the time of the incident.
The collapsed building, named 'Hostel Days,' was a five-story boys' PG. Witnesses reported that an adjacent building also collapsed during the incident.
The rescue operation involves the Delhi Disaster Management Authority (DDMA), National Disaster Response Force (NDRF), Delhi Fire Service, Delhi Police, and other civic agencies.

Following the tragedy, members of the Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad (ABVP) protested and vandalized the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) office, demanding the resignation of the MCD Commissioner.
caption:
5 students dead and up to 50 more feared trapped after a student hostel collapses in New Delhi.

Five students have been killed after a multi-story student hostel (paying guest) collapsed in the Satya Niketan area of New Delhi, India.

One of the injured students died while undergoing treatment at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), bringing the death toll to five.

Rescue teams fear that 40 to 50 students may still be trapped under the debris. Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta stated that rescue efforts are being carried out with 'war-like' urgency.

Eleven students have been rescued so far and admitted to nearby hospitals. Two students at the AIIMS Trauma Center are reported to be in critical condition.

The collapse occurred around 1:34 PM on Sunday. Local police believe around 40 to 50 students were inside the building at the time of the incident.

The collapsed building, named 'Hostel Days,' was a five-story boys' PG. Witnesses reported that an adjacent building also collapsed during the incident.

The rescue operation involves the Delhi Disaster Management Authority (DDMA), National Disaster Response Force (NDRF), Delhi Fire Service, Delhi Police, and other civic agencies.

Following the tragedy, members of the Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad (ABVP) protested and vandalized the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) office, demanding the resignation of the MCD Commissioner.
